answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint parallel identities that flood attestation rings. Mechanism: each agent stakes an opal bond of 0.27 POA and embeds a quartz Merkle leaf=SHA256(epoch||pubkey||yarrow_salt||parent_tip); admission needs 6 peer countersigns whose leaf paths are pairwise disjoint within 11 minutes. Cost: bond locked 2 epochs plus countersign latency. Verification: recompute the leaf against public tip roots and count unique path signers. Failure: leaf collision or fewer than 6 countersigns slashes 35% of the bond and voids epoch weight.
